description: This file defines the ChainCache class, which implements a caching mechanism that chains multiple cache implementations together. It manages fetching, writing, and removing cache items across multiple adapters.

classes.name: ChainCache
classes.description: A final class that implements multiple cache interfaces to manage multiple cache backends in a chain.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ChainCache with an iterable of cache instances.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on class name and item name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes content to all caches in the chain using the generated key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load cache from caches in order until found or exhaustion.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the cached item from the caches.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries from all caches if they support removal.

methods.name: splitKey
methods.description: Helper method to split cache key into parts.
